note: Four centering-ring presets (BalsaMachining and Rocketarium CR5060-W / CR5080-W) shipped with wrong diameters — a T50-to-T60 ring that could not reach a BT-60 wall. Fixed to the values three independent references agree on; the errors are live in the upstream community database, so a new corrections step in the preset pipeline keeps them fixed across refreshes. Matters since v0.042: ring preset diameters feed the printable STL and 1:1 DXF — re-export if you cut one of these four. Also: the validation harness gained the sharp-airfoil cell (175 -> 191 gates, first accuracy measurement of the fin path desktop imports use) and the ARCAS fins-off anchor was confirmed by an independent third read. No physics changed — every simulation gives v0.076's numbers exactly.
